about:

experiences.description:
In this role, I’ll continue to:
🔹 Lead our technical vision and drive innovation in Shopify Unified Commerce.
🔹 Mentor and grow our incredible team of developers, solution engineers, and project managers.
🔹 Build new solutions that extend Shopify into in-store retail and hospitality.
🔹 Partner with Ted Starkman, our Co-Founder & CEO, to align technology with business strategy.
🔹 Deliver client success and support record agency growth through scalable, impactful solutions.

Grateful for the opportunity, proud of what we’ve achieved, and energized for what’s ahead. 🚀

Chris Cowley is a technology visionary and project manager with more than 12 years of experience leading enterprise projects and business transformations in the retail and manufacturing sectors. As the VP, Digital Innovation & Technology, he’s been tasked with implementing C2’s strategic and creative technology plans for innovation, growth and global expansion. 
 
Chris kickstarted his career when he was just 18 developing retail networks and national POS solutions, eventually leading to large-scale Business Intelligence initiatives, product development, complete technology tool designs and implementation. His consumer-centric POV has allowed him to develop ideas and methods towards seamless technology integration for design and content enhancement, which makes him perfect for C2.  
 
SPECIALTIES: IT, PROJECT MANAGEMENT, STRATEGIC DEVELOPMENT, TECHNOLOGY INTEGRATION
Responsible for; corporate technology and creative design, business process engineering, corporate operations and the management of the human resources department.

Proudly coaching, mentoring and managing a dynamic team of IT, Creative and Operational professionals. Our vision is to deliver unique feature rich tools and applications to artists, celebrities and professional athletes that create new streams of revenue by utilizing great technology and a team of eclectic talent. 

 
- Facilitate the development, maintenance and monitoring of organizational plans
- Develop innovative initiatives to enhance internal efficiency and effectiveness
- Provide the operational leadership and project management necessary to support significant growth

- Manage corrective actions complaints. Review processes resulting in the complaint, and assess for areas of opportunity.
- Assist With implementing, maintaining and improving MOC with 5's and 6 sigma
- Define specifications for capacity planning 
- Build, maintain, improve material management strategies
- Assist in production planning 
- Assist in logistics planning
- Plan, define and assist in executing quarterly $3M + inventory

Our team specializes in Secure FTP, SQL DB Development and .NET.
Within this team I manage the Business and their needs and act as the primary liason between two Programmer Analysts and the users. We also manage the SDLC to a SOX standard on multiple projects ranging from HR Training Databases to Cognos BI reporting.
Project Manage the deployment and implementation of new retail technology; POS, VSAT and MPLS networks, back office servers and wireless.
